newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean AUK plans 11-for-100 rights.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean AUK plans 11-for-100 rights.

text.p: South Korea's AUK Corp said on Friday it plans to offer an 11-for-100 rights issue in August, raising its paid-in capital to eight billion won from seven billion won currently.
AUK Corp, a maker of transistors and light-emission diodes, said in a statement it would issue 200,000 common shares and allocate 20 percent of them to its employees.
The remaining 80 percent, or 160,000 shares, will be offered to its shareholders registered as of July 24 for the rights.
The issue price will be set at a 25 percent discount to the base price, which will be announced later, it said.
Subscription is set for August 20 and 21, with payment due on September 5, it said.
AUK shares closed at 60,000 won on Friday, up 200 won on the day. --Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5646
